items.name: slime
items.title: Slime
items.description: A glossy WebGPU slime that crawls, drips and splats. Hover and it reaches, click to splat it, drag to pull strands.
items.docs: Requires React 19 and three r171 or later. Render <Slime className="aspect-video w-full" /> anywhere. Slime owns a Canvas with a WebGPURenderer, which falls back to WebGL2 on its own. items.description: A dog-ear in the corner that peels the whole page back along a real fold to show what is drawn underneath.
items.docs: Wrap your page in <PagePeel underside={<YourUnderside />}>. The default scope is the viewport: the dog-ear sits in the bottom-right corner of the window. Use scope="container" to peel a single box. Put <PagePeelTrigger /> anywhere inside for a keyboard path.

props.description: Wraps the page and draws the corner, the folded flap and the underside.

props.description: Peel the window or the nearest box.

props.description: Share of the page peeled past which a release opens fully, about 60% of the diagonal. Below it the page settles back. A fast flick decides on its own.

props.description: Classes for the underside layer.

props.description: Classes for the page wrapper.
A native button that opens and closes the peel. Extends every button prop except onClick and type.

props.description: Button label.

accessibility: The corner and the open fold are pointer only. PagePeelTrigger gives keyboard and screen reader users the same toggle, with aria-expanded and aria-controls.
Open, the page is inert, focus moves to the underside and Escape closes it. Focus returns to the trigger.
Closed, the underside is inert and hidden from assistive tech.

items.name: dust-portrait
items.title: Dust Portrait
items.description: A picture printed as GPU dust that blows apart under the pointer, bursts on click and settles back on a spring.
items.docs: Requires React 19. Render <DustPortrait src="/photo.jpg" className="h-96 w-full" /> anywhere. DustPortrait owns a Canvas, so mount DustPortraitScene inside an existing Canvas or drei View when a page already has one, and pass pointerTarget the element the View tracks. The scene listens to pointer events on that element itself, so it works on a shared canvas with pointer-events: none.

props.description: A figure that owns one Canvas. Size it with className.

props.name: src
props.description: Image URL. An image from another origin needs CORS headers, because the grains are read from its pixels.

props.name: burst
props.description: A click or tap blows the dust outward from that point as a shockwave ring, then lets it settle home. Up to eight bursts stack.

props.name: focus
props.description: Focal point of the cover crop, x and y from 0 to 1 from the top left.

props.name: density
props.description: Multiplies the device budget of 45k to 120k grains. Small stages are capped so a grain never drops under 1.6 CSS px.

props.name: dispersion
props.description: How far grains swirl along the curl noise when scattered.

props.name: drift
props.description: How far scattered dust blows to the right.

props.name: idle
props.description: Keeps the portrait alive at rest: grains shed and return, more on the windward right side, gusts sweep across now and then, and the right side shimmers. true = 1, a number sets the strength (up to 3).

props.name: ink
props.description: Ground tone. Any three.js color string.

props.name: paper
props.description: Grain tone. Whichever of ink and paper is lighter decides the polarity, so the picture always prints as a positive.

props.name: paused
props.description: Holds the picture still and stops scattering.

props.name: alt
props.description: Accessible name of the figure.
props.default: "A picture printed in dust that scatters under the pointer"

The grains and their ground without the Canvas. Mount it in a Canvas or a drei View.

props.name: src
props.description: Image URL. An image from another origin needs CORS headers, because the grains are read from its pixels.

props.name: burst
props.description: A click or tap blows the dust outward from that point as a shockwave ring, then lets it settle home. Up to eight bursts stack.

props.name: focus
props.description: Focal point of the cover crop, x and y from 0 to 1 from the top left.

accessibility: A figure with an accessible name. The canvas is hidden from assistive tech.
Without WebGL it shows the source image in grayscale, cropped on the focal point.
Touch drags across the picture scatter it, while vertical drags still scroll the page.
Bursts are decorative. The figure stays a single image to assistive tech, and nothing is lost without them.

animation.timing: Always while visible. The scene stops invalidating once the dust settles and idle is off.
